# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where users organize and share ideas through Pins and boards, with comprehensive tools for creators, businesses, and developers including Pinterest API, Analytics, and Ads.

Pinterest serves multiple audiences: casual users discovering inspiration, content creators building audiences, businesses advertising products, and developers integrating Pinterest functionality. The platform emphasizes visual search, content curation, and community-driven discovery across diverse topics from art tutorials to business marketing.

## Key Topics

- Pins
- boards
- visual discovery
- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Ads
- Creator Hub
- content creation
- business accounts
- home feed
- visual search
- Pinterest Save Extension
- product catalogs

## Getting Started

- [All about Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/guide/all-about-pinterest): Platform overview explaining Pins, boards, and visual discovery features
- [Pinterest Create - Get Started](https://create.pinterest.com/get-started): Getting started guide for Pinterest account setup and content creation
- [How to Create Pins](https://create.pinterest.com/product-features/how-to-create-pins): Pin creation guide covering formats, specs, and best practices
- [Pinterest Create FAQ](https://create.pinterest.com/faq): FAQ covering Pinterest basics, creator guide, and monetization info

## Business & Advertising

- [Pinterest Business - How Pinterest Works](https://business.pinterest.com/how-pinterest-works): Explains Pinterest visual discovery platform for business advertising
- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com): Analytics dashboard for tracking Pin engagement and audience insights
- [Pinterest Ads Expert](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert): Free ads consultation service with Pinterest advertising experts
- [Pinterest Content Academy](https://create.pinterest.com/content-academy): Pinterest Content Academy with creator-led video tutorials and strategies

## Developer Resources

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com): Pinterest API documentation for conversions, content, and shopping
- [Pinterest Developer Platform](https://dev.pinterest.com): Developer platform for Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Tag integration

## Platform Access

- [Pinterest Pin Page](https://pinterest.com/pin): Pin page with login/signup functionality and autocomplete navigation
- [Explore Ideas (Australia)](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas): Australia ideas exploration page with trending topics and categories
- [Reactivate Your Account](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/reactivate-your-account): Account reactivation help for deactivated or closed Pinterest accounts
